name: 13 Frost & Honey (proposed, video 4)
status: PROPOSED in video 4's world bible (docs/v4/WORLD_BIBLE.md, W1, 2026-10-30); shown in the G4 look clip; goes into docs/look/palettes.json only after the owner approves it there (PALETTE.md 'How to use it').
mood: A cold blue snowy night with one honey-warm accent: the heat. T3's low key (ORGANIC.md section 8) as a night; the captions warm white on the night band (TYPE_GUIDE.md).
use_cases: a winter night in a city; any story about one warm thing in the cold (heat, a home, a light)
dna_notes: Breaks one DNA line on purpose: the light page (L* >= 75); its page is the night sky (the band at L* 31.3). Every role is out of lib/water neverBand's beige, olive and grey bands, at C* >= 8 (designed neutrals at 9). One hero (the heat's warm water, C* 40-52), one tinted dark anchor (#191F32), no separate pop (the lit window is the one look-here).
colors_note: palettes.json's role format: bg = the caption band (the night sky), ground = the street's far snow, disc/hl/pop = the story light (the honey; no separate pop), line = the darks' anchor (thin lines on things that are lines take their object's own deep shade), ink = the caption ink (warm white on night).
